title: ResolvedTestCaseVersion
description: The full manifest a runner needs to seed and validate a run, as returned by GET /test-cases/{slug}/versions/{version}. It is the authored test-case version with host-absolute paths rewritten to definition-store-relative `source` keys (a runner has no checkout), references resolved to backend-rendered screenshot URLs rather than mockup source, and the prompt template served inline. Spec and asset bodies are NOT inlined; they are fetched per file from the artifact endpoint using each `source` key.

description.description: The resolved description.md body. Site-facing context, NOT seeded into the workspace.

promptTemplate.description: The prompt.hbs Handlebars source, served inline because the runner renders it locally and it never hits the runner's disk.

assets.description: Asset files seeded into the workspace; authored directories are expanded to one entry per file.

commonReferences.description: Reference views shared by every variant, resolved to served media (rendered screenshots or static image/video).

commonProofs.description: Proof-of-implementation artifacts requested for every variant. Declarations only — the media is produced by the agent during a run, not served here.

commonReviewItems.description: Reviewer checklist items shared by every variant. Reporter-side material (not seeded): the reviewer must record a verdict for each before a run can be published.

domains.description: The case's scoring domains (case-level, not variant-scoped). A reviewer rates each independently; the run's overall rating is the worst across them. At least one is always present.

BuildCommands.description: The install and build commands run to validate an implementation.

source.description: Store-relative key the runner passes to the artifact endpoint to fetch this file's bytes.

dest.description: Path in the workspace the file is seeded to.

template.description: Whether `source` is a Handlebars (.hbs) template the runner renders before seeding. Defaults to false.

source.description: Store-relative key the runner passes to the artifact endpoint to fetch this file's bytes.

dest.description: Path in the workspace the file is seeded to.

ResolvedReference.description: A reference view resolved to its served media. A rendered mockup (`kind: rendered`) is a backend-rendered PNG; a static reference is the authored image (`kind: image`) or video (`kind: video`) served as-is. The runner downloads it, seeds it as the visual target, and (for an image) uses it as the validation baseline. The runner never receives a rendered reference's mockup HTML.

mediaUrl.description: Backend path to the served media (GET /test-cases/{slug}/versions/{version}/references/{scope}/{view}.{ext}, scope `_common` or a variant slug).

Proof.description: A proof-of-implementation artifact a test case asks the build to produce: a screenshot or short clip written to `dest` as evidence. Validation records whether it turned up; this is a declaration only.

id.description: Stable slug identifying the proof; recorded in validation and paired by review items.

kind.description: Media kind, inferred from the dest extension.

dest.description: Path, relative to the run workspace root, the build must write the proof to.

specs.description: Specs additive to the common specs, same shape.

references.description: References additive to the common references, resolved to served media.

proofs.description: Proof artifacts additive to the common proofs, requested only when this variant is selected.

reviewItems.description: Reviewer checklist items additive to the common items, surfaced only when this variant is selected.

ReviewItem.description: A reviewer checklist item a test case declares: something a reviewer must explicitly check after playing the build. Not seeded into the run. Worth `weight` points toward the run's score.

id.description: Stable slug identifying the item; recorded with the reviewer's verdict.

title.description: A short heading shown above the item in the reviewer UI, prefixed with a synthesized number at display time.

text.description: The prose a reviewer reads — what to check.

reference.description: Optional reference view shown as the expected target for this item.

proof.description: Optional proof id whose submitted media is shown for this item.

weight.description: How many points this item is worth toward the run's score: a pass earns this weight, a fail earns none, and the total available is the sum over the variant's effective checklist.

domain.description: Optional scoring domain (by id) this item belongs to, or null for a general item that belongs to no single domain.

Domain.description: A scoring domain a reviewer rates independently. The run's overall rating is the worst across all of a case's domains.

id.description: Stable slug identifying the domain; recorded with the reviewer's per-domain rating.

description.description: A brief description of what the domain covers, shown to the reviewer so they know what they are rating.

Check.description: A declared validation check: drive the implementation through `actions`, capture `view`, and compare against the reference identified by `referenceView`.

actions.description: An internally tagged CheckAction list (each item has a `type`), matching the browser-driver action contract.
